build_LatentLayersKLLoss: build a LatentLayersKLLoss module to compute KL divergence loss with uniform or aggregated posterior prior for latent layer samples
build_LatentLayersSparsityLoss: build a LatentLayersSparsityLoss module to compute sparsity and sharing loss across latent layers for multilingual models
test_LatentLayersKLLoss_forward: test the LatentLayersKLLoss forward method by passing layer samples, language index, update number, and sample size to compute KL loss
test_LatentLayersSparsityLoss_forward: test the LatentLayersSparsityLoss forward method by passing a list of layer samples, update number, and sample size to compute batch loss
review_LatentLayersSparsityLoss_is_valid: review the LatentLayersSparsityLoss is_valid method to check if sparsity loss should be applied based on the current update number
